note: The fonts a render may use (decision D6: one pinned permissive set). Each row names the file in this folder, its sha256, its licence (SIL Open Font License 1.1, texts beside the files: the licence asks for them to travel with the fonts) and its source. WEAKER PROVENANCE, stated on purpose: the files are Fontsource's Latin subsets of Inter and JetBrains Mono, not the upstream releases; the exact version of the npm packages they came from was not recorded, and the licence inside the packages was not read (the OFL texts here are the upstream projects'). A Latin subset draws Portuguese and English text; another script needs another file. A font that is not listed here is never used: the render falls back to the image's free font and says so.
